leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a function that accepts an array and a callback as arguments.
Construct a new array to store filtered elements based on callback logic.
Apply the callback to each element, using its value, index, and original array.
Manipulate the new array by conditionally pushing elements when the callback returns true.
Initialize and return the new array containing only the filtered items.
Integrate the custom filter function into a script and test it with sample data.
Control the iteration process to handle edge cases like empty arrays or sparse arrays.
